name: Iron Legionary
rules: Summon an Iron Legionary (18 HP, 4 Power). With 2+ Legionaries, split all hostile damage intended for the Warlock between them, before his Guard. Earned ranks return when summoned again.

name: Ash Pikeman
rules: Summon an Ash Pikeman (12 HP, 5 Power). +2 attack damage for each other Ash Pikeman. Earned ranks return when summoned again.

name: Ironhorn Bulwark
rules: Summon an Ironhorn Bulwark (28 HP, 2 Power). Defender. At turn start, give all soldiers 3 Guard. Earned ranks return when summoned again.

name: Maledictor
rules: Summon a Maledictor (14 HP, 3 Power). Attacks apply 2 Scorch. With 3 Maledictors, open a Hellgate at turn end: 6 damage and 2 Scorch to all enemies; promote all soldiers. Once per turn. Earned ranks return when summoned again.

name: Dread Vanguard
rules: Summon a Dread Vanguard (24 HP, 7 Power). Cleave all enemies. Its first kill each turn promotes it. Earned ranks return when summoned again.

name: Muster the Legion
rules: Summon 2 Iron Legionaries (18 HP, 4 Power each). Requires 2 empty Warband slots. Earned ranks return when summoned again.

name: Pike Detail
rules: Summon 2 Ash Pikemen (12 HP, 5 Power each). Requires 2 empty Warband slots. Earned ranks return when summoned again.

name: Field Promotion
rules: Promote a soldier: permanently gain +2 Power, +2 maximum HP, heal 2 HP, and +1 Armor. Earned ranks are saved for the next summon.

name: Blood Ascension
rules: Choose a soldier and sacrifice another summon. Promote the soldier 3 times.

name: Battlefield Commission
rules: Promote a soldier twice. Heal it 6 HP.

name: Rally the Legion
rules: Heal all soldiers 5 HP and give them 5 Guard.

name: Infernal Logistics
rules: Draw 2 cards. If you control 2 or more soldiers, gain 2 Cinders.

name: Hold the Line
rules: Gain 8 Guard. All soldiers gain 5 Guard.

name: Hellgate Rite
rules: Requires 3 Maledictors. Open the Hellgate now, then draw 2 cards. Only one Hellgate per turn.

name: Veteran's Command
rules: A soldier attacks. If it has been promoted, it attacks again.
